name: Katou Kotarou
source:
Jinyou living in Kamizawa. He works as a teacher in Kamizawa Academy. His father is a politician, and due to that he he's on good terms with Yatakarasu and Karasutengu.
His ancestor was a stone-youkai called Sekiyou, thus he can harden parts of his body into stone. The hardened parts then can deflect bullets or break things such as iron doors. He takes pride in being the strongest not just in Kamizawa Academy, but in whole Kamizawa.
Master of the Yata Raiten style. It's a style originally used by the tengu youkais to defend themselves against the assaults of humans. Youkais, while strong individually, can be overwhelmed by humans in large numbers, especially if they're carrying weapons, so Yata-Raiten style is actually focusing on fighting One vs Many using lighting-fast strikes with one's fists. Throughout the game he [spoiler]starts mentoring Soushichi too so he can learn this fighting style.[/spoiler]

He appears very very very briefly in Chrono Belt if one patches it to 1.1, as Fujieda Ayaka also interviews him in her omake section about [spoiler]what he thought of Kuki during their fight[/spoiler]. He is voiceless there though.
